w: Alex Malamy's malt-boiled, hearth-baked bagels — the Dodo Bagels pop-up turned Baltimore Ave shop (2023); on the Infatuation's 20 best in West Philly and Philly Mag's best-bagels guide for its mad-scientist sandwiches.
dish: The Ramen Thing bagel sandwich; everything and sesame bagels

w: Halal Indian barbecue in Southwest Philly — twenty items on the grill menu, skillets of whole charred fish and lamb chops, mains under $20; on the Infatuation's West Philly 20 and Visit Philly's 12 best Indian restaurants.
dish: Skillet-barbecued whole fish and lamb chops; chicken tikka

w: Hayat Alif's bright Ethiopian café-grocery at 45th & Baltimore (2020) — the traditional coffee ceremony, injera wraps of kitfo and collards; Billy Penn and the Inquirer's Cedar Park guide, ranked by Food & Wine among Philly's best lunches. Sister of Doro Bet.
dish: Ethiopian coffee ceremony; kitfo-and-collard injera wrap

w: Olney BYOB that the Infatuation calls Philly's best Haitian restaurant — griot, pwason fri, black rice and soup joumou; went viral for feeding neighbours its unsold food and became the diaspora's 2026 World Cup hub (WHYY, Billy Penn).
dish: Griot (fried pork); pwason fri; black rice; rasta pasta

w: Kurt Evans's Strawberry Mansion pizzeria that employs only formerly incarcerated people — Detroit-style pies (light, cushiony crust) named to the NYT's 2021 list of America's 50 most vibrant restaurants, Philly Mag Best of Philly (pizza), LaBan's new-pizza roundup and a Hulu documentary.
dish: Detroit-style square pies

address: 4600 N Broad St (at Belfield Ave), Philadelphia, PA 19140
w: The hot-pink Broad Street takeout window Sid 'Colonel of Shrimp' Booker opened in 1966 — battered shrimp baskets until the small hours; the 4600 block is co-named Sid Booker Way (2023). Infatuation North Philly guide, Philly Mag 'Eat This Now', Inquirer.
dish: Battered fried-shrimp basket with fries

w: Corner Puerto Rican restaurant on Fifth Street, the main artery of El Centro de Oro — Visit Philly's El Centro de Oro guide and the Inquirer's neighbourhood guide to Philadelphia's Latino heart.
dish: Puerto Rican corner-restaurant plates (comida criolla)

w: El Centro de Oro's favourite Puerto Rican pastries, baked by a Mexican chef at a Brazilian-owned shop — quesitos, pan sobao, pastelillos de guayaba and pan de agua (Inquirer neighbourhood guide; Visit Philly El Centro de Oro guide).
dish: Quesitos and pastelillo de guayaba; pan de agua

w: Raquel Villanueva Dang's Filipino café-market in Brewerytown (opened Feb 2025) — LaBan called it 'a bright new voice in Philly's Filipino scene'; Philly Mag's comfort-and-charm feature and the Infatuation's North Philly guide.
dish: Modern Filipino plates and market snacks

address: 1539 Cecil B. Moore Ave, Philadelphia, PA 19121
w: Small corner diner by Temple (2015), open early until 2pm — the Infatuation's North Philly guide and Philly Mag's where-to-eat-around-Temple pick for hangover breakfasts; reopened after a 2018 car crash (Inquirer).
dish: Breakfast classics — runny eggs, crispy bacon and home fries

w: Olney's original Korean grill (1982) in a drafty old diner car on North Fifth Street, still dropping cast-iron grates straight onto live charcoal — LaBan's Olney Korean-BBQ standard-bearer, Philly Mag, the Infatuation's North Philly guide.
dish: Charcoal-grilled marinated Korean barbecue with banchan

w: The region's original big craft brewery (1996), still brewing and pouring in the old Pepperidge Farm factory in Downingtown — HopDevil, Prima Pils, Golden Monkey at the source; Visit Philly's 15 essential breweries and Time Out.
dish: HopDevil IPA, Prima Pils, Golden Monkey at the original brewery

w: Upper Bucks brewery (2012) known for puckery sours, hazy IPAs and a dozen constantly rotating taps, food trucks outside — Visit Philly's 15 essential craft breweries; Inquirer suburban brewery coverage; Visit Bucks County.
dish: Fruited sours and hazy IPAs

address: 208 Carter Dr, Suite 2, West Chester, PA 19382
w: West Chester brewery born from two friends' homebrewing — a dozen-plus drafts heavy on New England and double IPAs and big stouts, dog-friendly taproom; Visit Philly's 15 essential breweries, Philly Mag, Inquirer.
dish: New England and double IPAs; stouts

address: 2616 E County Line Rd, Ardmore, PA 19003
w: Italian specialty market founded by Nicola and Angela Carlino in 1983 — prepared foods, breads, cheeses and focaccia stuffing; Main Line Today's Best Deli 2026 and a 2026 Inquirer 'Main Line mainstay' profile.
dish: Italian hoagies and prepared foods; sausage focaccia

address: 604 W Lancaster Ave, Bryn Mawr, PA 19010
w: Sandra Stauffer's Bryn Mawr bakery (c.1990), a Thanksgiving-pie institution — Main Line Today's Best Bakery 2026, Philly Mag Best of Philly (Best Pies), Inquirer's seven great suburban bakeries.
dish: Homemade holiday pies

w: Round-the-clock Lancaster Ave diner beloved by Villanova students and Main Liners — weekend-breakfast waits; Main Line Today's Best Diner 2026 (reader/critic vote) and a PhillyVoice regular.
dish: Diner breakfast platters

address: 5492 West Chester Pike, Newtown Square, PA 19073
w: Win and Sutida Somboonsong's Japanese-Thai dining room (WIN Hospitality) in Newtown Square — Main Line Today's Best Japanese and Best Sushi 2026; Philly Mag's Main Line sushi coverage.
dish: Sushi and Japanese-Thai plates

w: Tired Hands' production brewery and 180-seat taproom in a century-old Ardmore trolley-repair shop, with a 36-seat viking table — the cult saison/IPA brewer's flagship now that the original 16 Ardmore Ave brewpub went private-events-only (Inquirer, Feb 2026). LaBan's best brewpubs, Inquirer Main Line breweries 2025, Main Line Today, Visit Philly's walk-from-Regional-Rail breweries.
dish: Tired Hands drafts; ribs, burgers, tacos and house gelato

w: Port Richmond Puerto Rican restaurant glowing with island flavour and culture — Philly Mag Best of Philly (Best Puerto Rican Restaurant), the Inquirer's 2022 profile, the Infatuation's best Puerto Rican spots for its pernil, and 6abc.
dish: Pernil

w: Amy Rivera's pop-up-to-storefront Puerto Rican turnover shop in Fishtown — on Esquire's 2024 best new restaurants in America; Infatuation ('worth the line, every time'), Philly Mag, Inquirer (now a Sixers partner, Sep 2026).
dish: Fried pastelillos (Puerto Rican turnovers)

w: Tired Hands Brewing's Fishtown bar (2020) — the cult Ardmore brewer's only Philadelphia outpost, its saisons and IPAs on draught and to go; Inquirer, Philly Mag and PhillyVoice coverage, still open per the Inquirer's Feb 2026 Tired Hands report.
dish: Tired Hands beers on draught and to go

w: Chef Daniela Garcia's Colombian bakery-café (original on Wyoming Ave in Feltonville) — the Infatuation says it 'leads the pack' of Philly's Colombian spots; the $5 happy-hour Colombian hot dog made the Inquirer's 2026 best-hot-dogs map; 6abc Hispanic Heritage features.
dish: Colombian hot dog with pineapple salsa and crushed chips; Colombian breakfast

w: James Nardone's 16-seat Italian tasting-menu BYOB inspired by his grandmother — LaBan's 2024 round-up of three Italian tasting-menu splurges redefining Italian dining; on the Infatuation's 15 best in Fishtown.
dish: Seasonal Italian tasting menu of handmade pastas

w: No-frills slice shop in the old Pizzeria Beddia space — huge cheesy slices in four rotating flavours plus tomato pie; Philly Mag Best of Philly (Best Pizza), Visit Philly's best-pizza guide, the Infatuation's Fishtown 15, the Daily Meal's 101 best pizzas.
dish: Pepperoni and tomato-pie slices

address: 2302 E Norris St (at Tulip St), Philadelphia, PA 19125
w: Corner-storefront pasta and wine bar from Waywine Vineyards' crew — LaBan's 'Fishtown hit' review praises the ruffled mafalde and beet-pink ravioli with Pennsylvania wines; on the Infatuation's 15 best in Fishtown.
dish: Mafalde in peperoncino cheese sauce; tagliatelle with lamb ragù; PA wines

w: Germantown's warm Ethiopian café from Hayat Ali (sister to Alif Brew and Doro Bet) — Philly Mag Best of Philly (Best Ethiopian Restaurant), the Infatuation's Germantown & Mount Airy 20, 6abc.
dish: Ethiopian stew platters on injera; baked salmon

w: Sourdough bakery-café in a former Mount Airy insurance office with a posted daily bake schedule — the Inquirer's 'Northwest Philly's latest hit bakery', PhillyVoice, Chestnut Hill Local, the Infatuation's Germantown & Mount Airy guide.
dish: Sourdough loaves, focaccia and tomato-pie slices

w: Date-night bistro just off Germantown Ave in West Mount Airy (Oct 2025) that grew from a pandemic ghost kitchen — Latin and East Asian flavours with European technique, full bar; Inquirer, 6abc, Chestnut Hill Local, Infatuation.
dish: Latin-Asian small plates and cocktails

w: Germantown water-ice shop opened by Nobile and Olimpia Tranzilli in 1969 and still family-run — 20-plus flavours by the cup or gallon 'party bucket'; Inquirer, Visit Philly's best water ice, the Infatuation's Germantown guide.
dish: Water ice — creamsicle, mocha, lemon, cotton candy

w: Halal Nashville-style hot-chicken shop in Germantown — 12-hour-marinated tenders in heat levels from 'plain' to 'unbelievable'; on the Inquirer's halal hot-chicken guide and the Infatuation's Germantown & Mount Airy 20.
dish: Two-cluck slider and fries; cheesy clucker sandwich

w: Seasonal walk-in rooftop bar atop the repurposed Bok vocational school, views from New Jersey to West Philly, pop-up food and live music — on the Inquirer's best rooftop bars 2025, the Infatuation's review and Visit Philly's most memorable rooftops.
dish: Cocktails, cider and beer at sunset; rotating pop-up food

w: Jet Wine Bar owners Evan Malone and Jill Weber's Mexico City-style café on Washington Ave — pulled-pork cemitas, chicken tinga, horchata and Mexican coffees; Philly Mag and Visit Philly's Graduate Hospital guide.
dish: Pulled-pork cemita; chicken tinga; huevos rancheros

w: Two-floor Graduate Hospital gastropub with a constantly rotating beer list, revived in 2019 by Mike's BBQ's Michael Strauss and Stockyard's owners — Philly Mag Best of Philly (Best Pizza) and Visit Philly's Graduate Hospital guide.
dish: Rotating craft drafts; weekend brunch chicken-fried chicken

address: 2229 Grays Ferry Ave (23rd & South), Philadelphia, PA 19146
w: Post-Prohibition corner bar by the Monk's Café team, closed Jan 2025 and reopened under new owners in Sept 2025 with craft drafts and all-day egg sandwiches — Inquirer and Philly Mag reopening stories, Infatuation review, Visit Philly.
dish: Burger on an English muffin; house chips and dip; craft drafts

w: 'Jew-ish' breakfast-and-lunch café at 18th & Wharton (2026) — latkes, blintzes with seasonal jam and house-baked English muffins slathered in schmaltz; an early hit per the Inquirer, on the Infatuation's Point Breeze picks.
dish: Blintzes with seasonal jam; latkes; schmaltz English-muffin egg sandwich

w: Family-run Indonesian all-day café that started as pop-ups — among the first to serve Indonesian breakfast in Philly; Philly Mag's 'most comforting breakfast', the Inquirer's Indonesian-cafés story, the Infatuation's Point Breeze list.
dish: Nasi uduk breakfast platter — coconut rice, fried chicken, bakwan sayur, sweet-soy tempeh, sambal

address: S 19th St & Mifflin St, Philadelphia, PA 19145
w: Former barbershop turned parlour-style cocktail bar and bistro in Point Breeze (opened July 2026) that hands its kitchen to rotating guest chefs — Inquirer opening story, on the Infatuation's Point Breeze picks.
dish: Martinis with a prosciutto sandwich or shrimp cocktail; monthly guest-chef menus

w: Frankford Avenue bakery selling cream doughnuts since 1900 — the 'century-plus-old bakery' on Philly Mag's Northeast Philly guide, an Infatuation review, a Northeast Times landmark.
dish: Cream doughnuts

w: 24-hour Northeast staple on Cottman Ave — oversized omelets at dawn, burgers late at night; Infatuation review and best-diners-in-Philly guide; diners took cover here during the Jan 2025 Northeast plane crash (6abc).
dish: Oversized omelets; burgers

w: Marcie Turney and Valerie Safran's Mediterranean small-plates bar (2010) that turned 13th Street into Midtown Village's dining strip — Philly Mag Best of Philly (Best Dessert), Inquirer, Visit Philly.
dish: Mediterranean small plates; award-winning desserts

w: Turney and Safran's cosy Italian-American spot with a garden courtyard — Philly Mag Best of Philly (Best Outdoor Dining) and best-meatballs pick, Infatuation review, Thrillist's best Italian restaurants in the US (PhillyVoice), Visit Philly.
dish: Meatballs in red gravy; Italian-American classics

w: Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto's first American restaurant, opened with Stephen Starr in 2001 — set the local standard for modern Japanese dining and helped put Philly on the national map; Philly Mag Best of Philly (Best Japanese), Inquirer, Infatuation, Visit Philly.
dish: Omakase tasting; modern Japanese sushi

w: Joey Baldino's 35-seat Sicilian BYOB (2011) — the Vetri/Osteria alum's tribute to Anna Tasca Lanza's Sicily; LaBan 'passion in every dish' review, one of the region's best $55 prix fixes per the Inquirer's Collingswood guide, Philly Mag, 6abc.
dish: Sicilian prix-fixe — classic Italian dishes reworked the Sicilian way

w: University City's beloved halal Pakistani/Kashmiri kabob house (2000), kabobs fired to order over natural charcoal and naan from the tandoor — moved from 4201 Chestnut to a bigger Powelton space on Lancaster Ave in April 2026 (Inquirer); Philly Mag called it the city's best for kebabs.
dish: Charcoal-grilled halal chicken, beef, lamb and fish kabobs with tandoor naan

address: 29 E Gay St, West Chester, PA 19380
w: Low-lit, French-leaning cocktail-and-small-plates room in downtown West Chester (opened Jan 2025) — on the Inquirer's top restaurant openings of 2025 and Main Line Today's Best French Cuisine 2026.
dish: French-leaning small plates with cocktails and a curated wine list

w: Brewery born in a barn on the founder's family horse farm (2015), now anchoring the top of Phoenixville's Bridge Street beer strip — Visit Philly's Craft Beer Trail, Main Line Today's Phoenixville guide.
dish: Sugar Coated Pony Kisses NEIPA; We Are lager; fried Oreos

w: Phoenixville coffee-and-live-music hub since 1997, which added a nanobrewery in 2019 — signature Steel City Lager, kombucha and a Listening Room with music most nights; Visit Philly Craft Beer Trail, Main Line Today, Inquirer.
dish: Steel City Lager; house coffee and kombucha

w: Brewery in the 1910 Savoy Theater / old Hires Root Beer plant — a Craft Beer & Brewing 'Breakout Brewer' and part of the Inquirer's 'Phoenixville rises again' food-and-booze revival story.
dish: House lagers and IPAs in the old root-beer plant

address: 108-112 W State St, Kennett Square, PA 19348
w: The mushroom capital's mushroom-forward bistro — roasted mushroom soup from local Stinson's Farm mushrooms, mushroom en cocotte and stroganoff; the Inquirer's Kennett Square guide and Main Line Today (relocated to a larger State St space). HELD lead from W4 cleared.
dish: Roasted mushroom soup with local Kennett mushrooms; mushroom en cocotte

address: 111 W State St, Kennett Square, PA 19348
w: State Street coffee shop (2013) pouring Ceremony Coffee Roasters beans that some call the best in the state — the Inquirer's Kennett Square guide and Main Line Today.
dish: Espresso drinks and pour-overs on Ceremony beans

address: 231 E State St, Kennett Square, PA 19348
w: Kennett Square's homemade Mexican ice-cream shop — majarete, queso fresco, tequila, flan and avocado flavours; the Inquirer's Kennett Square guide and Main Line Today.
dish: Queso fresco, majarete and avocado ice creams

w: Chadds Ford's 75-year-old breakfast-and-lunch diner by the Brandywine — 'old-school favorites and Wyeth sightings' (Inquirer) — destroyed by Hurricane Ida's flooding in 2021 and rebuilt flood-proof, reopening July 15 2025 (6abc, CBS Philadelphia, Main Line Today).
dish: Classic breakfast and lunch specials

w: Brandywine Valley winery founded in 1982 — approachable, food-friendly wines reflecting the Mid-Atlantic uplands microclimate, 30,000+ cases a year; Main Line Today purveyor spotlight, Visit Philly's regional wine guide, Inquirer.
dish: Tasting flights of Brandywine Valley wines

address: 50 S Main St (Ghost Light Inn), New Hope, PA 18938
w: Jose Garces's riverside restaurant in the Ghost Light Inn (2019) — the enduring spaghetti pie, thoughtful cocktails, local vegetables and seafood, heated patio; Inquirer first look, 6abc FYI Philly, Visit Bucks County.
dish: Spaghetti pie; local seafood plates

address: 32 S Main St, New Hope, PA 18938
w: New Hope's indoor food market (2017) with a dozen vendors — Peruvian empanadas and arepas at Lima Fusion, ham sandwiches and cheese-drenched tots at Pork Shack, Dole Whip at Salty Pineapple; the Inquirer's New Hope guide and Visit Philly's New Hope lunch pick.
dish: Lima Fusion empanadas and arepas; Pork Shack tots

address: 8 W Mechanic St, New Hope, PA 18938
w: Intimate wine, beer and whiskey lounge just off Main Street — an award-winning wine list and themed whiskey flights (Japanese, Scotch, bourbon, local rye) with shareable plates; Inquirer New Hope guide, Visit Philly, Visit Bucks County.
dish: Themed whiskey flights; wine and small plates

address: 102 E State St, Kennett Square, PA 19348
w: 34-seat seasonal American bistro run by husband-and-wife chefs Zack and Karessa Hathaway — reviewed by Craig LaBan (Dec 2023) and spotlighted by Main Line Today for its fresh-ingredient cooking. (Not to be confused with Sweet Amalia in Hammonton.)
dish: Seasonal bistro plates from local produce
